name: a1_fishing_bays
notes: Fishing bays on the west bank of the a1 river, hand-selected by the map author (5 records): three rafts, a fish hut and a 32 m pier with a shed, strung along 112 m of beach on the inside of a bend. WATER IS TO THE EAST (facing 90). A SHORE pattern: every piece is fitted to the water surface (15,305 cm at the source), not to the ground -- raft decks -32..+50 cm of the surface standing in 1.0-1.4 m of water, the hut +120 on dry sand 5 m back, the pier +300 starting on the beach and running out over 1.5 m of water. Stamp with water_cm = the target's surface; no pad. Ground not saved: beach sand 01/03 with a pebble band, 10 m wide. To put the water on bearing B, rotate_deg = (90 - B) mod 360.
